title: acs ship workflow (workflows/ship.yaml)
description: The declarative pipeline /acs:ship drives: an ordered list of steps, each naming a build/test/ship skill (workflows/phases.yaml is the registry; merge-pr and release are never steps), what it needs, and the predicates that skip (`when`) or block (`requires`) it. Version 2 (ADR-0095) adds delivery paths: `delivery` names the step after which /acs:ship judges the plan onto one path, a step's `paths` filters it to some of them, and `skill`/`boundary` may be given as a mapping keyed by path. A consumer override at <repo>/.acs/workflows/ship.yaml replaces the plugin default wholesale. Semantic checks beyond this schema — unique ids, `needs` naming EARLIER steps, `stop_after` existing, predicate names known, path names drawn from the declared vocabulary, per-path mappings covering it, every path-dependent step descending from `delivery.classify_after`, an acyclic DAG — live in acs_lib.workflow.validate_workflow.

version.description: 2 since ADR-0095. A version-1 file is refused with a migration pointer: it predates delivery paths, so its single `code` step names a skill that no longer exists.

stop_after.description: The step whose completion ends the run; must be a step id.

max_parallel.description: How many READY steps `workflow next` may hand back at once in `parallel` mode.

delivery.description: The delivery-path branch point. Omit it and the workflow has no paths: no step may carry `paths` or a per-path mapping.

classify_after.description: Step id; once it is satisfied, /acs:ship judges the plan onto one path and records it on the ticket. Every path-dependent step must descend from this one.

paths.description: The path vocabulary, cheapest first. Each name is a value `delivery_path` may take in pipeline-state.json.

skillName.description: phases.yaml build + test + ship skills and their internal legs, minus merge-pr and release (acs_lib.workflow.allowed_ship_skills).

skill.description: The skill to invoke — one name, or a mapping keyed by delivery path when the step is implemented differently per path. A mapping must name every declared path.

needs.description: Ids of EARLIER steps that must be satisfied (completed, or skipped by a false `when` or a non-matching `paths`) first.

when.description: Skip the step (recorded as `skipped`) when this predicate is false.

paths.description: Run this step only on these delivery paths; on any other path it is recorded `skipped`, exactly as a false `when` is. Absent = every path.

requires.description: Block the step (reported as `blocked_by` with a pointer) while this predicate is false.

args.description: The skill's argument string; `{ticket_id}` is substituted.

boundary.description: Where /acs:ship must stop rather than carry the step's context onward — one value, or a mapping keyed by delivery path. A path the mapping omits has no boundary.

exclusive.description: Run alone: never in a parallel batch.
